purpose: Lead decisions that the interface files do not carry yet: combustion.json v2.4 (REV-COMB-2 R2-01, R2-02, R2-05; CHANGELOG 172 (6)) and the GNC rev2 decisions (CHANGELOG 175) on texts the datasheet quotes. While the stale text is still in a target, the datasheet shows the decision from the cited CHANGELOG or REQUIREMENTS text instead of the stale wording. Each entry checks itself: the cited source must contain every 'verify' string and every number of 'value'; a target is applied only while its stale wording is still present. Rev1 (ovr-4): the same rule on combustion.json v2.4d, gnc.json v3.2 and electronics.json v4.
drop_when: per entry, when the generator reports it REDUNDANT (combustion.json v2.4a and gnc.json v3.1 published). Targets inside the append-only CHANGELOG never become redundant: they mark a superseded clause of an older decision for as long as it is quoted.

rules.value: Short statement of the decision. Every number in it must appear in the cited source text (checked by the generator; ERROR otherwise).
rules.sources: Locators the generator reads: CHANGELOG line and item (contains = sentence filter) or the newest lead decision citing a text (line_contains, no item), REQUIREMENTS amendment bullet (by its leading text; contains = sentence filter), a JSON pointer, a review register list entry, or a review-file line (line_contains).
rules.targets: Displayed source keys the decision overrides. mode annotate: stale wording struck through and the decision inserted; replace: decision shown, stale text kept below, struck through; append: decision appended (target lacks the decided term). stale_re: regex that must match for the target to be active; absent_re: target active while this regex does NOT match.
rules.suppress: Superseded values that are not shown at all. Display text matching a pattern is masked; numeric keys listed in pointers are withheld. corroborate_re must match a key of combustion.json /superseded_v2p4/v (the author's own withdrawal list) or the entry is reported.
rules.short: Optional shorter statement inserted in annotated text; its numbers are checked like those of value.
